caption: The drawing depicts a transparent glass pitcher with a broad, rounded base that tapers upward to form a narrow neck and a wide, outward-curving spout. The single handle is ornate, featuring a curved, elongated shape with a subtle decorative element where it is attached near the body of the pitcher. The glass has visible highlights and shading, rendered in shades of gray, white, and subtle hints of beige, which indicate reflections and the transparency of the material. There is a faint, light beige shadow cast around the pitcher on the background, suggesting a light source from the upper right. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or embellishments. The artist's signature "atkinson - 6.39 -" is visible in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Vinegar Cruet
